changes.title: 6,600 noncitizens registered to vote by New Jersey motor vehicle system error, Gov. Sherill says
changes.summary: The Democratic governor, who took office this year, blamed a Motor Vehicle Commission system software error but said a preliminary analysis showed that fewer than 400 of the people registered that way went on to cast ballots.

changes.title: Error Led to 400 Noncitizens Voting in New Jersey, Governor Says
changes.summary: A 2023 software glitch at the state’s Motor Vehicle Commission led to roughly 6,600 noncitizens being registered to vote during the Murphy administration, Gov. Mikie Sherrill announced.
